title: G30 · 拒绝
body: I changed only `wordFreqTopK`, retaining the other seven functions unchanged. The new path avoids empty split tokens, uses a prototype-safe object-backed stable-ID dictionary with a lazy Map fallback for special property names, packs counts in a Uint32Array, and selects results through count buckets that allocate only returned rows and sort words only within equal-count groups. This preserves exact whitespace, frequency, count-descending, and word-ascending semantics while removing several Map, comparator, and allocation costs; the expected word-task gain is large enough to target the required aggregate improvement above 51.6×.
